requirement_vague: Create two items, then fetch all items and confirm the created items appear.
requirement_precise: Authenticate as a superuser using the credentials (username 'admin@example.com', password 'password123') to obtain an access token. Create two items in the database using the superuser credentials. Then retrieve the list of items with the superuser token. Verify that the response status code is 200 OK and that the returned data contains at least the two items that were created.

implementation.reasoning: The code initializes the superuser with the required credentials at startup, provides a login endpoint that returns an access token, allows authenticated active users (including the superuser) to create items, and exposes a GET /api/v1/items/ endpoint that returns all items with the default 200 OK status. Since created items are committed to the database and the list endpoint returns all stored items, the two created items will appear in the returned data.
